frontend_phase_accounting.source_identity: inline opaque stamp and node count; included in typed owner capacities, no shared heap allocation
frontend_phase_accounting.parser_lookahead_work: each token probe, including EOF, in arrow and type/reference lookahead admitted before inspection
frontend_phase_accounting.parser_non_arena: diagnostics and comprehensive parser traversal/recursion work uninstrumented; individual Logos calls are not preemptible

frontend_phase_accounting.checker_module_graph: ownership/dependency/order validation work and shared iterative schedule work/storage admitted; exact dependency/import/export capacities
frontend_phase_accounting.checker_analyzer: scope/narrowing, type-parameter, return, constructor and generator context vector backing admitted; dropped and released per Analyzer without releasing shared declarations
frontend_phase_accounting.checker_binary: existing iterative expression visits and continuation probes charged; continuation vector backing/growth admitted and released after each expression, including nested overlap and ordinary failures
frontend_phase_accounting.checker_narrowing: leaf queries and iterative traversal probes charged; pending/answer vector backing and growth overlap admitted and released per query; nested maps/types remain uninstrumented
frontend_phase_accounting.checker_narrowing_reuse: binary continuations retain syntax-only guard inputs/projections; empty branches are skipped, retained guards re-resolve in the active scope; no result cache or source reassociation
frontend_phase_accounting.checker_remaining: nested type/signature/default payloads, hash/ordered maps, alias/local-resolution scratch, debug consistency scratch, diagnostics and comprehensive checker traversal/native stack work uninstrumented
frontend_phase_accounting.conversion_construction: pre-admitted graph and temporary storage; retained charges transfer into publication
